q-110716.worked_solution:
We will use the difference of squares formula:

$$
(a+b)(a-b)={a}^{2}-{b}^{2}

$$

$$
(a+b)(a-b)={a}^{2}-{b}^{2}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}({x}^{n}+3{y}^{n})({x}^{n}-3{y}^{n}) & = \\ {({x}^{n})}^{2}-(3{y}^{n})^{2} & = \\ {x}^{2n}-{3}^{2}\cdot ({y}^{n})^{2} & = \\ {x}^{2n}-9{y}^{2n}.\end{aligned}
$$

Question 10

(xn+3yn)(xn−3yn)=

a
x2n−6xnyn−9y2n
b
x2n+3xnyn−9y2n
c
x2n+9y2n
d
x2n−9y2n
e
x2n+6xnyn−9y2n
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

We will use the difference of squares formula:

(a+b)(a−b)=a2−b2

Substituting a=xn and b=3yn, we have

(xn+3yn)(xn−3yn)=(xn)2−(3yn)2=x2n−32⋅(yn)2=x2n−9y2n.
